requirements.contract: Drop the current item binding, then drop the iterator exactly once, then exit the nearest loop; a cleanup failure replaces the break with an error.
Run current-binding and iterator cleanup exactly once; cancellation remains primary and cleanup failures are attached as ordered secondary failures.
A cleanup failure replaces normal end, break, continue, or function return; an existing propagated error or cancellation remains primary with cleanup failures attached in observation order.
Drop the current item binding before requesting the next item from the same iterator; a cleanup failure exits with an error instead of advancing.
Drop the current item binding and iterator exactly once before the return value leaves lexical scope; a cleanup failure replaces the return with an error.
Drop each completed item binding and then the exhausted iterator exactly once; a cleanup failure becomes the loop result error.
Drop the current item binding and iterator exactly once; preserve the propagated error as primary and attach cleanup failures in observation order.

negative_cases.expected: iteration.cleanup_failure replaces break and no later iterator step executes
the original error remains primary and iteration.cleanup_failure is attached once as secondary
reject proof containing more than one cleanup event for the same item binding or iterator
reject proof missing cleanup on normal end, break, continue, function return, propagated error, or cancellation
